content.overview: Prescribed companies must appoint independent directors under s. 149(4), meeting the criteria in s. 149(6) and Schedule IV.
content.glance: Prescribed companies must appoint independent directors under s. 149(4), meeting the criteria in s. 149(6) and Schedule IV.
content.study: Independence looks at relationships, pecuniary links and relatives. Tenure is up to five years, with one reappointment by special resolution and a three-year cooling off. No stock options. Liability is limited to knowledge, consent, connivance or lack of diligence. They chair or compose the audit and nomination committees.
